title: The card offers this or a new work order; elsewhere only Create work order
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Enroll units 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and 'ZZAUTOTEST 403' so PM-A reads Overdue on both.
  4. On the customer page press New Work Order, choose unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and create the work order (it opens as an estimate). Note its number, for example S3780-15904.
  5. On the work order page, find the Maintenance schedule card inside the asset card at the top and press Expand.
custom_steps:
1. On the PM-A row press Add Service and read the destination choices.
  2. Choose Create a new work order instead and press Add. Open the new work order's Lines tab.
  3. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). Find the PM-A row for 403 and read the actions it offers.
  4. Open unit 403's Maintenance tab and read the actions on the PM-A row.
  5. Back on the first work order, press Add Service on PM-A again and hover the (i) beside Create a new work order instead; press Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • From the work order card, Add Service offers this work order or a new one (in the design: Add to this work order and Create a new work order instead).
  • Choosing a new work order creates one that carries PM-A's 4 canned lines.
  • The worklist row and the asset's Maintenance tab offer Create work order only, with no choice of an existing work order.
  • The (i) gives the reason for a second destination (in the design: “A technician with three hours left cannot take on ten more lines. Same pattern as DVI findings.”).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10573 (S17, Add a service to a work order); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S17; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboards W2a / L3; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S17-R1: “Adding from the work order card offers this work order or a new one. The worklist and the asset tab offer Create work order only, because neither has a current work order”
  • S17-R2: “Adding will bring the service's canned lines with it, or at another location the same work, per S16-N6”
  • Design, Chunk 2 board, artboards W2a / L3, (i) beside Create a new work order instead: “A technician with three hours left cannot take on ten more lines. Same pattern as DVI findings.”
  • S17-N1: “Adding a service is permission gated and must offer the second destination, because a technician with three hours left cannot take on ten more lines”
